### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] settings.mcs.yml preserves the initialized identity, environment, language, and authoring mode.
- [ ] All 4 implemented operations are represented by instructions, a packaged skill, or a bound tool.
- [ ] Exactly two synthetic knowledge files are loaded and clearly labeled fictional.
- [ ] Record **not applicable to this disconnected workshop** for the production-only criterion: “Every production source uses a dedicated, least-privilege connection reference.”
- [ ] Every locked persona prompt returns its deterministic synthetic evidence and the relevant human approval boundary.
- [ ] Never sign, certify, transmit, or claim completion of a regulator filing.
- [ ] Never predict an audit outcome or provide legal advice.
- [ ] Public value statements remain qualitative; exact figures appear only as synthetic evidence.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate, user-approved step after push and validation.

Source: [catalog acceptance contract](../../../solutions/catalog.json).
